Names are the author's own, which are pak folders as often as page titles, and the lookup reads folders for that reason. loadAfter.name: CompatibilityFramework
loadAfter.why: Reported in issue #135: the mod page states that with Compatibility Framework installed this mod must load after it or it will not work. VOLO was doing the opposite, filing it as Bug Fixes on three section observations and lifting it eleven groups above the framework it depends on. Three separate things agree and none of them is decisive alone: the reporter's quotation of the mod page, which nobody here has read directly; two independent working orders that place the framework first and none that place it second, which is one witness short of the three the corpus normally requires; and the Nexus listing, which files this as Equipment rather than Bug Fixes. A stated constraint from the author outranks three section observations either way.

loadAfter.why: Published by the mod's own author as the general load order for the Valkrana set and the mods built around it. An author stating the sequence for their own work is the strongest ordering evidence there is: everything else here is inferred from what players happened to do. Names are the author's own, which are pak folders as often as page titles, and the lookup reads folders for that reason. The one exception is the Animate Dead add-on, written here as the corpus names it because its page title and folder both order the words differently from the author's list.

placement.why: Reported in issue #241 as showing Unplaced. The evidence here is the author's published sequence and the sibling, not witnesses: Sailor Cat's order puts Skeleton Crew directly after Valkrana's Skeleton Crew Feat, which sits in Classes on forty-one section observations, and the sequence rule already holds Skeleton Crew behind the Feat. The mod itself appears in six submitted orders, three of them independent and working, and none files it under a section header, so no section could win for it. Placed beside the Feat so the badge says where it goes. Three independent working orders filing it under a header supersede this.
